newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian Birzai Dairy 1996 profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian Birzai Dairy 1996 profit falls.

text.p: Leading Lithuanian dairy company Birzai on Wednesday said it made a net 1.89 million litas profit in 1996 after a 3.85 million litas profit the previous year.
Birzai is one of Lithuania's leading companies and is quoted on the main list of the stock exchange.

The company said in a statement of unaudited figures that its sales and services last year came to 85.56 million litas while its gross profit was 12.35 million litas. The company's assets came to 72.8 million litas.
It did not give comparisons for any figure other than the profit figure.
It last year became the first Lithuanian corporate to issue global depositary receipts (GDRs), worth $6.0 million which was arranged by Nomura and local bank Vilnius Bank.
